'''D.J. Burgess''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[November 2000 Dartmouth tournament]] on 25 November 2000 with EBO, according to Michael Pistone's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1497">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-11-26-dartmouth-ma-11-25-00d1497/ dartmouth-ma-11-25-00], DeckTech (Michael "MadSkills84" Pistone, 26 November 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-11-26-dartmouth-ma-11-25-00d1497/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
